integrity: Proof uses transparent exact-rational finite enumeration plus global analytic symmetry and volume arguments; computational tests do not replace the latter.
scientific_limitations: Exact theorem only for the specified two-periodic point set and metric. Independent historical priority unresolved because a potentially relevant companion note was not available in full. Nonmaximal Delaunay cells and all-dimensional optimization not addressed.
title: A single deepest-hole orbit and four-fifths Delaunay volume in a five-dimensional two-periodic set
